legenda:
One ticket, one price: the Sugarloaf cable car costs R$ 205 (≈ US$ 37) 🚡
🎟️ Full adult ticket: both cable car legs + the whole park, all day
🕗 Open 8:30 am–9 pm, weekends from 7:30 am
🌅 Last boarding 7:30 pm: go late and stay for sunset
👧 Half price for ages 3–12, 60+ and students with ID; under 2 free
🥾 Fit? Hike the 30-min trail up Morro da Urca and ride from there with a special ticket
